title: MIT exp8: relation detection and hypothesis equivalence are different judgments
preparation: Source-derived post hoc illustration. Labels are judgments by the author, not independent reference truth. Distinguish meaningful cross-hypothesis links from exact recurrence.
label_definition: RELATED means the notes can inform one another within the research problem, even if the interventions differ. SAME means the exact intervention/question being tested recurs. Neither label by itself implies independent evidence or authorizes Gate promotion.
caveats: Retrospectively selected, author-provisional examples. All pairs belong to MIT experiment 8. RELATED is not evidence of independent confirmation. Binary SAME/DIFFERENT labels from earlier draft are not a valid false-positive verdict for thematic clustering. A blind evaluation needs independent annotation and actual unrelated controls.
